services.title: Auto Insurance
services.summary: Car policies, usually bound the same day.
services.text: Car policies quoted across numerous A-rated carriers, and in most cases bound the same day, normally within a few minutes.
services.lead: It can be difficult to determine what type of car you should invest in and what benefits roll along with each option, but now it is easier than ever to make these decisions. We will help you understand them all and how to protect you and your vehicle.
services.imageAlt: A white pickup truck on an open road at sunset

covers.title: Same day coverage
covers.text: Most auto policies are written the same day, normally within a few minutes of the call.

covers.title: Discounts on your rate
covers.text: We look for the discounts on car insurance rates that you qualify for across the carriers we represent.

covers.title: Bundling with home
covers.text: Writing auto alongside homeowners or another policy can qualify you for further discounts.

covers.title: Claims help
covers.text: When you have a loss we give you the carrier's claims number and answer questions about the process.

services.title: Homeowners Insurance
services.text: There are a lot of different ways we can keep your home protected, from custom packages that include windstorm coverage to a simple consult on what your options are.
services.lead: There are a lot of different ways we can keep your home protected. From custom packages that include wind storm coverage in tier 1 and tier 2 areas to a simple consult on what your options are, we have got all your home needs covered.

covers.title: Windstorm in tier 1 and tier 2
covers.text: Custom packages that include wind storm coverage for homes in tier 1 and tier 2 areas.

covers.title: Bundled discounts

services.title: Flood Insurance
services.summary: Flood policies, separate from your home policy.
services.text: Flood is written as its own policy, and we place it through the National Flood Insurance Program and through private flood carriers.
services.lead: Flood water is not covered by a homeowners policy, so it is written separately. Ask us about flood cover for your address, and we are the people you call when it is time to file.
services.imageAlt: A village street standing under flood water

about.title: A one-stop shop for all things insurance-related.
text: At Loggins Insurance of Crosby our insurance agency is here to help you. From requesting a quote for car insurance, business or home to a custom package that fits all of your needs, we are your one-stop shop for all things insurance-related.

As an independent agency, we have the flexibility to offer numerous A-rated insurance carriers to find the coverages and rates that meet your personal or business needs. Call us today for your free quote.
Rick Loggins, Jr is your hometown insurance agent, proudly serving Crosby, Dayton, Huffman and Mont Belvieu.

Safety First tips for you and your family

facts.heading: Bundling
facts.text: Bundling your auto, homeowners and other types of insurance can qualify you for discounts. We can help you create an insurance package that will take advantage of all of the discounts available to you.

facts.heading: If you have a loss
facts.text: Our first concern is for you and your family to be safe and well. In the unfortunate case that you have a loss or damages, first take action to prevent further damage or loss. Take pictures as proof of loss or damage. File a claim with your insurance company as soon as possible. If you have questions about the claims process, we are here for you.
